# Golden encodings of moonpool-rpc references (protobuf, protocol version 1).
#
# Independent of Rust: each line is `name hex`, and the bytes follow the
# field tables in the `ServiceRef` / `InterfaceRef` docs (every field
# always written, in tag order). A change to any line is a wire break.
#
# service: ServiceRef, method 0x6563686f, schema 1, codecs 1->1, public,
#   incarnation 0x0102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f10, token 3#7, 10.0.1.1:4500

# well-known: the same method, private, incarnation 0 (ignored at
#   admission), token index 1<<63 | 42 (well-known id 42), generation 0

#   incarnation as above, token 5#1, [2001:db8::1]:4500
